data.one_liner: A designed toast notification widget with animations and built-in themes.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated toast notifications for Flutter applications with support for multiple built-in types such as success, warning, error, info, and delete. Allows full customization of colors, icons, positioning, layout orientation, and entry animations.
use_when: You need to show temporary status messages or user feedback like success or error.
You want customized toast notifications with smooth animations and theme support.
avoid_when: You require persistent in-app notifications or snackbars tightly integrated with Scaffold state.
You are handling system-level push or local background notifications.
strengths: Smooth animations with multiple entry types
Built-in success, warning, error, and info styles
Supports RTL text direction and responsive constraints
weaknesses: Limited to overlay-based toast popups rather than general UI components
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build steps required.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need simple, native-looking toasts with minimal configuration.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: For modern styled toast notifications with flexible design and rich animations.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a highly flexible toast and notification manager with custom loading and notification builders.
